extraction_notes: This is a family datasheet; the BZT52C5V6S row was selected from the BZT52C2V0S through BZT52C75S table.
The supplied PDF SHA-256 was verified as 8d99c0b95ddbd62581320fd03378a72d97d914bc201c735536cd50e5f6753113.
The Fig. 1 zener characteristic points are digitized readings from the plotted BZT52C5V6S trace; source-axis current in mA was converted to A and no intermediate points were interpolated.

The BZT52C5V6S electrical-characteristics row gives VZ = 5.2 V minimum, 5.6 V nominal, and 6.0 V maximum at IZT = 5 mA; maximum ZZT is 40 ohm at IZT, maximum ZZK is 400 ohm at IZK = 1 mA, and admissible IZM is 5 mA.
The same row gives maximum IR = 1 microA at VR = 2.0 V and temperature coefficient limits of -2.0 to +2.5 mV/degC at IZTC.

Maximum ratings include PD = 200 mW and forward voltage VF = 0.9 V at IF = 10 mA, both at Ta = 25 degC; junction and storage temperature limits are -55 to +150 degC and typical RthetaJ-A is 417 degC/W.

No capacitance or reverse-recovery specification is published in the supplied datasheet. The remaining page 3 plots are series-wide typical characteristics without a uniquely identified BZT52C5V6S trace and were not assigned component-specific points.
